newsitem.title: NORWAY: Fokus Bank to sell BNbank shares to DnB. [CORRECTED 12:02 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Fokus Bank to sell BNbank shares to DnB. [CORRECTED 12:02 GMT]

text.p: Fokus Bank ASA said on Friday it had agreed to sell its 10 percent stake in BNbank ASA to Den norske Bank ASA (DnB) . The announcement paved the way for DnB to take over the niche mortgage lender.

Fokus also said DnB had agreed not to sell its 8.49 percent (Corrects from 9.98 percent) shareholding in Fokus to Sparebankgruppen, a group of savings banks that has launched a hostile takeover bid for Fokus.
Fokus said it agreed to sell to DnB its 975,397 shares in BNbank, corresponding to 10 percent of stock in the mortgage lender.
The sale would give Fokus a profit of 41 million crowns.
Fokus has recommended its shareholders turn down the takeover bid by Sparebankgruppen, which wants to carve up Fokus among its 16 members.
Simultaneously, Fokus and Dnb have launched rival bids for BNbank.
